name: 杂志 Serif
description: 印刷级杂志大字风 + Source Serif/Georgia 衬线 + 黑白对比 + 正红 #D11A2A 点缀。超大 H1 (30px) 居中压字距、H2 小型大写下 1px 细线、H3 italic 斜体、H4 uppercase 红色标签、p 两端对齐+首行缩进。适合深度解读/人物稿/读书笔记/长评论。

styles.container: background-color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Source Serif Pro',Georgia,'Songti SC','PingFang SC',serif;
styles.h1: font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; color: #111111; text-align: center; line-height: 1.3; margin-top: 36px; margin-bottom: 26px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; padding-bottom: 14px; border-bottom: 3px solid #111111; font-family: 'Source Serif Pro',Georgia,'Songti SC',serif;
styles.h2: font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #111111; line-height: 1.35; margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 16px; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #111111; letter-spacing: 1px;
styles.h3: font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; font-style: italic; color: #111111; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 26px; margin-bottom: 14px; font-family: 'Source Serif Pro',Georgia,'Songti SC',serif;
styles.h4: font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #D11A2A; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 10px; letter-spacing: 2.5px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.h5: font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #333333; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.5;
styles.h6: font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #666666; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: 1px;
styles.p: font-size: 17px; color: #111111; line-height: 1.9; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 18px; letter-spacing: 0.2px; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote: font-size: 19px; color: #333333; line-height: 1.75; text-align: center; font-style: italic; border-top: 2px solid #111111; border-bottom: 2px solid #111111; background: transparent; font-family: 'Source Serif Pro',Georgia,'Songti SC',serif;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 19px; color: #333333; line-height: 1.75; margin-bottom: 0; letter-spacing: 0.3px; background: transparent; font-style: italic;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; border-radius: 0; display: block; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px; background: transparent;
styles.hr: margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 32px; height: 3px; width: 60px; background: #111111; border: none;
styles.code: background: #F2F2F0; border-radius: 2px; font-size: 90%; color: #111111; font-family: 'SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
styles.pre: background: #F9F9F5; border: 1px solid #E0E0DC; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; color: #111111; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 30px; background: #111111; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #111111; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 14px;
styles.th: text-align: left; font-weight: 700; color: #111111; background: transparent; border-bottom: 2px solid #111111; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 12px;
styles.li: font-size: 17px; color: #111111; line-height: 1.9; letter-spacing: 0.2px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 6px; align-items: flex-start;
styles.footnotes h2: font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #111111; margin-bottom: 12px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.footnotes li: font-size: 13px; color: #555555; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; word-break: break-all;
